 for mode in ['bank-0-checks','bank-1-check','wing-0-checks']:

     worst=np.maximum(worst,[np.max(abs(inferred-truth)),np.max(abs(w-w0)),obj-min(lower,c['dual_lower_bound']),np.max(abs(grad-nu-c['lam_lower']+c['lam_upper']))])
